title: Marrok
description: Known in a past life as the First Brother of the Empire's Inquisitorius, Marrok was an elite hunter of Jedi. After the collapse of the Empire, the strong, silent Inquisitor found work as a mercenary. Hired by Morgan Elsbeth, he worked alongside Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati to steal the parts necessary to build a massive hyperdrive ring large enough to bring Grand Admiral Thrawn back from a distant galaxy. He obscured his face and wielded a red, double-bladed Lightsaber familiar to Inquisitors.
